title: Should I just skip the band session on the 15th?

msgs.text: Should I just skip the band session on the 15th?

must: say Maya is in Lisbon from October 14 to 18, so she can't be at the session on the 15th in person
give a take in one line with its reason (yes, skip it, or what to do instead), not a list of options
never: hand the decision straight back with "it's up to you" and nothing else
